summary: A single mobile screen centred on a near-white (#fdfdfd) canvas: a rounded phone panel (656,200 → 970,883, corner radius ~40 px) filled edge to edge with an oil-painting landscape. It has a pale beige-teal sky at the top, a dark green tree mass on the right with a brown trunk running down the centre, purple hills on the left and yellow-green foliage at the lower left. Across the painting, concentric water-like ripples spread from one point at the spinner (~812,650). Each ring bends and offsets the painted strokes, with a faint bright crest along its leading edge and no drawn stroke. The rings travel outward continuously at about 60 px/s, ~100 px apart, so a new crest leaves the centre about every 1.7–1.9 s. This runs the whole 24 s, and the rest of the screen holds still. The foreground UI is static and centred on x≈812. A small translucent light disc (~68 px) sits at ~812,650 and holds a white 8-spoke spinner icon with a dark centre dot. The spinner does not rotate. Below it sits a translucent, slightly lightened rounded card (674,648, 277×158, radius ~22) whose top edge passes behind the spinner disc. The card holds three centred lines of ~13 px white body copy. At the bottom is a solid white pill button (674,824, 277×44) labelled "Get Started" in ~13 px dark medium-weight type. Type is a neutral grotesk (Inter-like).

criteria.check: The area outside the phone panel is a flat near-white (#fdfdfd) with no texture or gradient
The phone panel spans about x 656–970 and y 200–883 (≈314×684 px), centred horizontally at x≈812
The panel's four corners are rounded with a radius of about 40 px
The panel has no visible border stroke or drop shadow: the painting meets the white page directly
The panel is filled edge to edge with a painted landscape, with no empty or flat-colour areas

The painting shows the same picture as the clip: pale beige-teal sky at the top, a dark green tree mass on the right, a brown trunk running down near the centre, purple hills at the left middle, and yellow-green foliage at the lower left
The painting shows visible brush strokes and canvas grain, not a smooth gradient or flat vector shapes
The painting has no visible tile seams or repeats anywhere in the panel
Concentric circular ripples are visible across the painting, sharing one centre at about (812,650) on the spinner
Each ripple reads as the painting bending: strokes are shifted and offset across the arc (e.g. the dark tree edge breaks into stepped arcs at x 870–970)
Ripples are NOT drawn rings: no solid or outlined circle strokes, no flat coloured bands, and no uniform-width line lies on top of the painting
Each ripple crest carries a faint, soft bright rim on its outer edge (a light glint along the arc), not a hard line
About 4 ripple crests are visible above the spinner along the centre line at x≈812 (near y 277, 383, 488 and 590), spaced roughly 100–105 px apart
The ripple crests have moved outward (away from the spinner) by about 25–30 px between the two moments, while the painting underneath stays in place
Ripples expand at a steady ~60 px/s: a crest edge in column x≈880 climbs from y≈368 to y≈308 between the two moments
Ripples keep spreading throughout the clip: crest positions differ between 18 s and 18.5 s just as they do earlier
New rings keep appearing at the centre: the ring pattern repeats with a new crest leaving the spinner every ~1.7–1.9 s, with no pause or reset jump
The panel's silhouette, page background, card, spinner and button do not move; only the painting inside the panel changes between the two moments
A translucent circular disc about 68 px across is centred at about (812,650)
The disc lightens the painting behind it slightly (semi-transparent white tint), with the painting still visible through it and no hard outline
A white spinner icon sits at the centre of the disc
The spinner has exactly 8 spokes evenly spaced around the centre
The spokes are solid white bars with rounded ends, all the same brightness (no fading tail)
A small dark round dot (~8 px) sits at the spinner's centre, inside the ring of spokes
The spinner spans about 44 px across (x 790–834, y 628–672), centred at (812,650)
The spinner does not rotate: its spokes are at the same angles at both moments
A rounded translucent card spans about x 674–951, y 648–806 (≈277×158 px), centred at x≈812
The card's corners are rounded with a radius of about 20–24 px
The card is a soft translucent light tint: the painting and ripples stay visible and nearly sharp through it, slightly lighter than outside
The card is NOT opaque, NOT a heavy frosted blur, and has no visible border stroke
The spinner disc overlaps the card's top edge: the disc centre (y≈650) sits on the card's top edge (y≈648)
The card reads exactly 'Take control of your finances with' / 'budgets that fit your needs and help' / 'you reach your goals faster.' as three lines
The body copy is centred on x≈812, with line baselines about 19 px apart (lines centred near y 708, 727, 746)
The body copy is ~13 px regular-weight sans-serif in near-white (slightly soft, ~90% white), not pure bold white
The button spans about x 674–951, y 824–867 (≈277×44 px), the same width as the card and ~18 px below it
The button is a solid opaque white pill with fully rounded ends and no border or shadow
The button label reads exactly 'Get Started'
The label is ~13 px medium-weight near-black type, centred in the button at x≈812, y≈846
The button's bottom edge sits about 16 px above the panel's bottom edge, with painting visible below and beside it
No other UI appears on the page: no status bar, no title, no page indicator dots, nothing outside the panel
